acceptanceCriteria: A batch job credits obligations and writes a per-obligation-cause summary without any agent session.
A final with any retry > 0, failed post-check or new neighbour failure is NOT QUALIFIED and the pack names the reason.
A repeat-failure obligation without new fixture evidence is refused before lane acquisition.
Spec requirements recorded and owner-accepted; #714 answered on the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#714. Native run-batch/qualify: claim attempt, pool acquire, prep+health; batch: run named specs once, credit obligations into the ledger, write per-obligation step-level summary (witnessed / failed with step error / not reached / not named); final: static checks, N retry-0 runs, any retry or post-check failure disqualifies, changed-directory run with failing neighbours re-run on base, verdict pack; capture server errors before reset, release HANDOFF, write result for next session; refuse repeat same-error failure without new fixture proof. Reuses pool, health, gate run, obligation ledger (#712) and preflight (#713).
title: GH #714: corvint-tasks run-batch / qualify native deterministic batch runner and final qualification
